title: Measuring Arizona agriculture’s export contributions and sensitivity to trade policy shifts
Motivations and barriers to integrated management of annual bluegrass in sports fields: US survey findings
Agricultural economic water productivity differences across counties in the Colorado River Basin
abstract: This study estimates the relative contribution of different factors to the wide variation in agricultural economic water productivity (EWP) across Colorado River Basin counties. It updates EWP measures for Basin counties using more detailed, localized data for the Colorado River mainstem. Using the Schwarz Bayesian Information Criterion for variable selection, regression analysis and productivity accounting methods identified factors contributing to EWP differences. The EWP was USD 1033 (USD 2023)/acre foot (af) for Lower Basin Counties on the U.S.–Mexico Border, USD 729 (USD 2023)/af for other Lower Basin Counties, and USD 168 (USD 2023)/af for Upper Basin Counties. Adoption rates for improved irrigation technologies showed little inter-county variation and so did not have a statistically significant impact on EWP. Counties with the lowest EWP consumed 25% of the Basin’s agricultural water (>2.3 million af) to generate 3% of the Basin’s crop revenue. Low populations/remoteness and more irrigated acreage per farm were negatively associated with EWP. Warmer winter temperatures and greater July humidity were positively associated with EWP. When controlling for other factors, being on the Border increased a county’s EWP by USD 570 (2023 USD)/af. Border Counties have greater access to labor from Mexico, enabling greater production of high-value, labor-intensive specialty crops.
abstract_zh: 科罗拉多河流域各县农业经济水生产力的差异。本研究估计了不同因素对科罗拉多河流域各县农业经济水生产力（EWP）广泛差异的相对贡献。我们利用更为详细、更具地方性的科罗拉多河干流数据，更新了流域各县的 EWP 测度。我们使用施瓦茨贝叶斯信息准则进行变量选择，并结合回归分析和生产率核算方法，识别出导致 EWP 差异的因素。位于美墨边境的下游流域县的 EWP 为每英亩英尺 1033 美元（2023 年美元）；下游其他县为每英亩英尺 729 美元（2023 年美元）；上游流域县则仅为每英亩英尺 168 美元（2023 年美元）。改良灌溉技术的采用率在各县之间差异不大，因此对 EWP 没有统计上显著的影响。EWP 最低的县消耗了全流域 25% 的农业用水（超过 230 万英亩英尺），却仅创造了全流域 3% 的作物收入。人口稀少/偏远以及每个农场的灌溉面积较大，与 EWP 呈负相关。冬季气温较高和七月湿度较大，则与 EWP 呈正相关。在控制其他因素后，位于边境地区使一个县的 EWP 提高了每英亩英尺 570 美元（2023 年美元）。边境县更容易获得来自墨西哥的劳动力，从而能够生产附加值高、劳动密集型的特色作物。

title: Agricultural water footprints and productivity in the Colorado River Basin
abstract: The Colorado River provides water to 40 million people in the U.S. Southwest, with river basin spanning 250,000 square miles (647,497 km2). Quantitative water rights assigned to U.S. states, Mexico, and tribes in the Colorado Basin exceed annual streamflows. Climate change is expected to limit streamflows further. To balance water demands with supplies, unprecedented water-use cutbacks have been proposed, primarily for agriculture, which consumes more than 60% of the Basin’s water. This study develops county-level, Basin-wide measures of agricultural economic water productivity, water footprints, and irrigation cash rent premiums, to inform conservation programs and compensation schemes. These measures identify areas where conservation costs in terms of foregone crop production or farm income are high or low. Crop sales averaged USD 814 per acre foot (AF) (USD 0.66/m3) of water consumed in the Lower Basin and 131 USD/AF (USD 0.11/m3) in the Upper Basin. Crop sales minus crop-specific input costs averaged 485 USD/AF (USD 0.39/m3) in the Lower Basin and 93 USD/AF (USD 0.08 per m3) in the Upper Basin. The blue water footprint (BWF) was 1.2 AF/USD 1K (1480 m3/USD1K) of water per thousand dollars of crop sales in the Lower Basin and 7.6 AF/USD 1K (9374 m3/USD1K) in the Upper Basin. Counties with higher water consumption per acre have a lower BWF.
abstract_zh: 科罗拉多河流域的农业水足迹与生产率。科罗拉多河为美国西南部 4000 万人口提供用水，其流域面积达 25 万平方英里（647,497 平方公里）。分配给美国各州、墨西哥和各部落的法定水权总量超过了年径流量。气候变化预计将进一步限制径流量。为平衡水资源需求与供给，有人提出了前所未有的用水削减方案，主要针对农业部门，因为农业消耗了全流域超过 60% 的水资源。本研究建立了县级、全流域范围的农业经济水生产力、水足迹和灌溉现金租金溢价测度，以为保护计划和补偿方案提供依据。这些测度识别出那些以损失作物产量或农场收入衡量的保护成本较高或较低的地区。下游流域平均每消耗一英亩英尺（AF）水，作物销售额为 814 美元（0.66 美元/立方米）；上游流域为 131 美元/英亩英尺（0.11 美元/立方米）。扣除作物特定投入成本后的作物销售额，下游流域平均为 485 美元/英亩英尺（0.39 美元/立方米），上游流域为 93 美元/英亩英尺（0.08 美元/立方米）。下游流域的蓝水足迹（BWF）为每千美元作物销售额对应 1.2 英亩英尺（1480 立方米）水；上游流域为每千美元 7.6 英亩英尺（9374 立方米）水。每英亩用水量较高的县，其蓝水足迹较低。

title: Arizona policy responses to water shortage: Can they have an impact?
Burn Period: A use-inspired metric to track wildfire risk across Arizona and New Mexico in the southwest U.S
abstract: Numerous tools and indices exist for wildland fire managers to anticipate and track changes in wildfire risk driven by variability in weather and climate conditions at hourly to seasonal scales. However, in working closely with Southwest U.S. managers, we learned of a simple meteorological metric being informally used, but not widely accessible in existing tools or information products, to gauge short-term changes in wildfire risk. This metric, termed “Burn Period” (BP), is the local count of hours per day with relative humidity values equal to or less than 20%. Our collaboration led to the development of an experimental tool called the “Burn Period Tracker” to ease access and promote the use of BP values for planning and response. This study is a climatological analysis of BP values at 124 fire weather stations across Arizona and New Mexico for the period 2000–22 to aid in interpretation and understanding of this use-inspired metric. BP values reflect the strong seasonality in temperature and moisture deficit–driven wildfire risk across the Southwest United States, with risk climbing through the arid spring season, peaking in June, and then falling rapidly with the onset of the summer monsoon in July. Regression analyses show that short-term variability in BP values is driven by variability in low-level atmospheric moisture in all months with strongest relationships during the summer after the onset of the monsoon. This study highlights the utility of BP as a short-term wildfire planning tool as well as an example of collaborative weather and climate services development.
abstract_zh: 野火管理人员有许多工具和指数，可用于预测和追踪由小时至季节尺度的天气与气候变化所引起的野火风险变化。然而，在与美国西南部管理人员密切合作的过程中，我们了解到一种简单的气象指标正被非正式地使用，但在现有工具或信息产品中并未得到广泛获取，该指标用于衡量短期野火风险的变化。这一指标称为“燃烧期”（Burn Period，BP），即每天相对湿度小于或等于20%的本地小时数。我们的合作促成了一个名为“燃烧期追踪器”（Burn Period Tracker）的实验性工具的开发，以便于获取BP数值，并促进其在规划和应对中的使用。本研究对亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州124个火险气象站2000–22年的BP数值进行了气候学分析，以帮助理解和解释这一源自实际应用需求的指标。BP数值反映了美国西南部温度与水分亏缺驱动的野火风险的强烈季节性：风险在干燥的春季逐步攀升，6月达到峰值，随后在7月夏季季风来临时迅速下降。回归分析表明，在所有月份中，BP的短期波动均由低层大气水分的变化所驱动，其中在季风来临后的夏季关系最为密切。本研究突出了BP作为短期野火规划工具的效用，也是天气与气候服务协同开发的一个范例。

title: Demand for information for wildland fire management
Differential effects of drought on Arizona state park visits: Implications for visitor spending and local economies
abstract: This study examines the influence of drought on monthly visits to Arizona State Parks from 1990-2018, controlling for park attributes and economic factors. Drought effects depend critically on drought length. Long-term drought (measured by 24-month Standard Precipitation Index (SPI)) discourages visits, while short-term drought (measured by 1-month SPI) encourages visits. The overall effect of drought on visits in a given month depends on the relative strength of these countervailing effects. Studies of drought impacts on outdoor recreation that select too short of a drought time span may fail to adequately capture negative effects. Considering four severe drought years in Arizona (2002, 2003, 2004, and 2018), the combined effects of short- and longer-term drought ranged from a 1% increase to a 4.4% decrease in annual visits. Associated changes in local economic output (sales), including multiplier effects, ranged from gains of $1.2 million to losses of $7.1 million annually. Projections of greater aridification in the U.S. Southwest suggest that the negative effects of longer-term drought may grow more dominant over time. Results also suggest climate warming will shift demand for park visits from summer to winter months and from low desert parks to higher-elevation parks in the north of the state. Future park planning and management may wish to consider the implications of these seasonal and spatial shifts.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了1990–2018年干旱对亚利桑那州州立公园月度游客量的影响，并控制了公园特征和经济因素。干旱效应关键取决于干旱持续时间。长期干旱（以24个月标准降水指数SPI衡量）抑制游客量，而短期干旱（以1个月SPI衡量）则刺激游客量。某一月份干旱对游客量的总体效应取决于这两种相反效应的相对强度。若在研究干旱对户外游憩影响时选取的干旱时间跨度过短，则可能无法充分捕捉其负面影响。考虑亚利桑那州四个严重干旱年份（2002、2003、2004和2018年），短期与长期干旱的综合效应使年度游客量变化范围为增加1%至减少4.4%。相关的地方经济产出（销售额）变化（包括乘数效应）范围为每年增加120万美元至减少710万美元。美国西南部日益干旱化的预测表明，长期干旱的负面效应可能随时间推移而变得更为主导。结果还表明，气候变暖将使游客需求从夏季转向冬季，并从低沙漠公园转向本州北部海拔较高的公园。未来的公园规划与管理可考虑这些季节性和空间变化的影响。

title: How are weather and climate products and decision support systems used in wildland fire decision making in the US Southwest?
abstract:
Wildland fire management is a challenging environment in which to utilize scientific information. Despite the robust information system that supports U.S. wildland fire management, recent studies demonstrate that some data/information products and decision support tools available to that community are not being used to their full potential. In the U.S. Southwest, the convergence of climate change, past wildland fire policy, and an expanding wildland–urban interface have increased pressure on wildland fire managers to use science-based information to improve management outcomes. This tension between the perceived need for more science in fire management and the practical challenges of using science to inform decisions led us to ask two basic questions: 1) How is information about weather and climate used in wildland fire management decision-making in the Southwest? 2) How are decision support tools used in Southwest wildland fire management? We found that relatively few sources of weather and climate information are consulted by Southwest wildland fire managers; a small percentage of those sources are used to inform the specific decisions and tasks we asked about; and decision support tools are commonly used to justify rather than inform decisions. We further found evidence that suggests that products and tools that are thoughtfully designed to fit within the specific information use environment of wildland fire management—rather than being produced in isolation from that environment—are more likely to be used and therefore have more impact than those that are produced in isolation from that environment.
This study set out to understand how weather and climate information and decision support systems (DSSs) are perceived and used by the Southwest wildland fire management community. We found that the wildland fire community consults relatively few weather and climate products, even fewer are used to inform decisions, and that DSSs are frequently used to justify rather than inform decisions. We argue that the climate services community and other scientists who develop science-based tools and products for fire management will benefit from better understanding the information use environment in which their science may be used if they want to increase the utility of their work.
abstract_zh:
野火管理是一个难以利用科学信息的环境。尽管美国野火管理拥有完善的信息体系，但近期研究表明，该领域可获得的部分数据/信息产品和决策支持工具并未得到充分利用。在美国西南部，气候变化、过去的野火政策以及不断扩张的野地—城市交错区共同加大了野火管理人员运用基于科学的信息改善管理成效的压力。管理者对野火管理中更多科学支持的感知需求，与运用科学为决策提供依据的现实挑战之间的这种张力，促使我们提出两个基本问题：1）在西南部的野火管理决策中，天气和气候信息是如何被使用的？2）在西南部的野火管理中，决策支持工具是如何被使用的？我们发现，西南部野火管理人员查阅的天气和气候信息来源相对较少；这些来源中只有很小比例用于为我们所询问的具体决策和任务提供依据；决策支持工具则通常用于为已做出的决策提供辩护，而非为决策提供依据。我们还发现证据表明，那些经过精心设计、以适应野火管理特定信息使用环境的产品和工具，比脱离该环境独立制作的产品和工具更可能被采用，因而影响力也更大。
本研究旨在理解西南部野火管理群体如何感知和使用天气与气候信息以及决策支持系统（DSS）。我们发现，野火管理群体查阅的天气和气候产品相对较少，用于为决策提供依据的则更少，而DSS经常用于为决策辩护而非提供依据。我们认为，气候服务界以及其他为火灾管理开发基于科学的工具和产品的科学家，若希望提高其工作的实用性，将大有裨益地更好理解其科学成果可能被使用的信息使用环境。

title: How does herbicide resistance change farmer’s weed management decisions? Evidence from the Roundup Ready experiment
abstract: Adoption of diverse weed management practices is viewed as essential for slowing the spread of herbicide-resistant (HR) weeds. Yet, adoption of diverse tactics has remained low, while there has been explosive growth of resistant weeds. This study analyzes U.S.-farm-level data to identify factors affecting adoption of diverse weed management practices. This study uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to consider how practice adoption is influenced by different causal pathways between farmer and farm characteristics and farmer awareness of and concern over HR weeds. This study then uses multiple regression analysis to estimate the direct and indirect pathways that influence practice adoption. Respondents relied more heavily on herbicide-based weed control methods than on mechanical or cultural methods. Concern over herbicide resistance increased the number of practices farmers adopted and the percentage of acres where farmers implemented these practices. Practice adoption was negatively associated with increasing levels of farmer risk aversion. Technological optimism—belief that new herbicides would soon be developed to counter HR weeds—discouraged diverse herbicide use practices that combat resistance, but encouraged use of some non-chemical weed control methods. Perceived weed dispersal externalities (from weed mobility) led to more diverse weed management, running counter to hypotheses that greater mobility reduces incentives for individual resistance management.
abstract_zh: 推广多样化的杂草管理措施被视为减缓抗除草剂（HR）杂草扩散的关键。然而，尽管抗性杂草呈爆发式增长，多样化策略的采用率却一直很低。本研究利用美国农场层面的数据，识别影响多样化杂草管理措施采用的因素。本研究使用有向无环图（DAG）刻画农场主与农场特征以及农场主对HR杂草的认知与担忧之间的不同因果路径，如何影响措施的采用。随后，本研究采用多元回归分析估计影响措施采用的直接和间接路径。受访者对除草剂类杂草防治方法的依赖远高于机械或农艺方法。对除草剂抗性的担忧增加了农场主采用的措施数量，以及实施这些措施的面积比例。措施的采用与农场主风险厌恶程度的提高呈负相关。“技术乐观主义”——即相信新除草剂将很快被研发出来以应对HR杂草——抑制了用于应对抗性的多样化除草剂使用措施，但鼓励了部分非化学杂草防治方法。感知到的杂草扩散外部性（源于杂草的移动性）促使农场主采取更为多样化的杂草管理，这与“移动性越强，个体抗性管理的动机越弱”的假设相反。

title: Factors that influence on-farm decision-making: Evidence from weed management
abstract: Scholars with an interest in agricultural social change have a long history of studying farmer decision-making. While much of the early research was focused on identifying the individual characteristics of progressive farmers, research has evolved into examinations of the many factors that may influence different types of farm decision-making, including the use of so-called Best Management Practices. We utilize an approach for analyzing farmer decision-making that includes some possible internal and external factors for understanding how farmers are responding to the emerging crisis of herbicide-resistant weeds. Based on survey data collected onfarm managers, we contrast farmers that are using an herbicide-centric approach with those who are adopting practices associated with integrated weed management. Our findings indicate that farm decision-making is a complex process that is influenced by a variety of factors.
abstract_zh: 长期以来，关注农业社会变革的学者一直在研究农场主的决策行为。早期研究多聚焦于识别先进农场主的个体特征，而后续研究则逐步扩展到考察可能影响各类农场决策的诸多因素，包括所谓“最佳管理实践”的采用。我们采用一种分析农场主决策的方法，纳入了一些可能的内部和外部因素，以理解农场主如何应对日益严重的抗除草剂杂草危机。基于对农场经营者的调查数据，我们对比了采用以除草剂为中心方法的农场主与采用综合杂草管理相关实践的农场主。研究结果表明，农场决策是一个复杂的过程，受到多种因素的影响。

Do farmers manage weeds on owned and rented land differently? Evidence from US corn and soybean farms
abstract: BACKGROUND: It has been frequently argued that growers have less incentive to manage the evolution and spread of herbicide-resistant weeds on leased than on owned land. This is because resistance management provides long-term rather than short-term benefits that operators may be less assured of capturing on land they do not own. Yet, empirical evidence supporting this argument has been lacking. RESULTS: This study reports on results from a large-scale national survey of weed management and other crop production practices on US agricultural fields. Up to 11 weed management practices were compared across owner-operated versus renter-operated fields. Analysis of survey data from corn and soybean fields did not support the hypothesis that adoption of resistance management practices is lower on rented acres. In most instances, there were no statistically significant differences in herbicide use or weed management practices on rented versus owned land. This was true at both national and regional levels of analysis. Where there were significant differences, practices associated with greater herbicide resistance management were, as often as not, more prevalent on rented than owned land. CONCLUSIONS: A useful area of future research would be to test for land tenure differences in resistance management using multivariate analysis to control for confounding effects. Unobserved farmer or land characteristics may be confounding results and masking land tenure effects. Results here, however, suggest that these other effects are dominating any obvious disincentive effects of land leasing on resistance management. Of greater concern, the adoption of key resistance management practices was low on both owned and rented land. © 2020 Society of Chemical Industry.
abstract_zh: 背景：常有观点认为，相较于自有土地，租赁土地上的种植者管理抗性杂草的演变与扩散的激励较弱。这是因为抗性管理带来的是长期而非短期收益，而租地经营者可能不太确定能否在非自有土地上获取这些收益。然而，支持这一论点的经验证据一直缺乏。结果：本研究报告了一项大规模全国性调查的结果，该调查涉及美国农田的杂草管理及其他作物生产措施。对自营与租用田块上多达11种杂草管理措施进行了比较。对玉米和大豆田块调查数据的分析并不支持“租用土地上抗性管理措施的采用率较低”这一假设。在大多数情况下，租用土地与自有土地在除草剂使用或杂草管理措施方面没有统计学上的显著差异。无论是全国层面还是区域层面的分析，均是如此。在存在显著差异的情况下，与抗性管理相关的措施在租用土地上的普及程度往往不亚于甚至高于自有土地。结论：未来一个有益的研究方向是，使用多元分析控制混杂效应，检验土地保有权差异对抗性管理的影响。未观测到的农场主或土地特征可能混淆结果，并掩盖土地保有权的效应。然而，这里的结果表明，这些其他效应主导了土地租赁可能对抗性管理产生的明显负向激励。更令人担忧的是，关键抗性管理措施在自有和租用土地上的采用率均较低。© 2020 Society of Chemical Industry.

title: The U.S. dairy industry in the 20th & 21st century
Farmer attitudes toward cooperative approaches to herbicide resistance management: A common pool ecosystem service challenge
abstract: Dramatic growth in herbicide-resistant (HR) weeds in the United States threatens farm profitability and may undercut environmentally beneficial farming practices. When HR weeds move across farm boundaries due to ecological processes or human action, a common pool resource challenge emerges, requiring farmer cooperation to manage such weeds effectively. We investigate the scope for cooperative management using responses to a national survey on HR weed issues to test a recursive model of three preconditions for collective action: (1) concern about HR weeds migrating from nearby lands; (2) communication with neighbors about HR weeds; and (3) belief that cooperation is necessary for effective resistance management. Results suggest that farmers who relied more on Extension educators regarding weed management, were more likely to satisfy each precondition. Further, concern about weeds resistant to multiple herbicides as well as concern about HR weed mobility positively influence concern about migration and views toward cooperation. Farmer time constraints and “techno-optimism” (a belief that herbicide discoveries will solve resistance problems) detract from the perceived need for cooperative approaches. A different set of factors significantly affect each precondition, suggesting heterogeneity in the underlying casual mechanisms. The findings can help tailor collective action to different socio-ecological settings experiencing HR weed resistance issues.
abstract_zh: 美国抗除草剂（HR）杂草的急剧增长威胁着农场盈利能力，并可能削弱有利于环境的农业实践。当HR杂草因生态过程或人为活动而跨越农田边界扩散时，就出现了公共池塘资源问题，需要农场主之间的合作才能有效管理此类杂草。我们利用一项关于HR杂草问题的全国性调查的回复，检验集体行动三个前提条件的递归模型，以考察合作管理的空间：（1）对来自邻近土地的HR杂草迁入的担忧；（2）与邻居就HR杂草进行沟通；（3）相信合作对于有效的抗性管理是必要的。结果表明，在杂草管理方面更依赖推广教育人员的农场主，更有可能满足上述每一项前提条件。此外，对同时抗多种除草剂杂草的担忧，以及对HR杂草移动性的担忧，均正向影响对迁入的担忧以及对合作的态度。农场主的时间约束以及“技术乐观主义”（即相信除草剂的新发现将解决抗性问题）削弱了对合作方法必要性的感知。不同的因素显著影响每项前提条件，表明其背后的因果机制具有异质性。这些发现有助于针对经历HR杂草抗性问题的不同社会生态环境，量身定制集体行动方案。

title: How low can you go? Measuring impacts of reduced pesticide use
Simple approaches to examine economic impacts of water reallocations from agriculture
venue: Journal of Contemporary Water Research & Education
abstract: Facing an anticipated shortage declaration on the Colorado River and reductions in surface water for agricultural use, rural stakeholder groups are concerned about how water cutbacks will affect their local economies. Local farm groups and county governments often lack the analytical tools to measure such impacts. While one can learn much from large‐scale hydro‐economic models, data, cost, and time limitations have been barriers to such model development. This article introduces three basic modeling approaches, using relatively low‐cost and accessible data, to examine local economic impacts of water reallocations from agriculture. An empirical application estimates the effect of agricultural water reductions to Pinal County, Arizona, the county that would be most affected by a Colorado River Shortage Declaration. Water cutbacks to agriculture are modeled using two variants of a “rationing” model, which assumes that farmers will fallow their acres that generate the lowest gross returns (Rationing Model I) or the lowest net returns (Rationing Model II) per acre‐foot of water. Rationing models have modest data requirements given that crop and region specific data are available. Building off these simpler rationing models, an input‐output (I‐O) model provides more detailed information about the impacts on different rural stakeholder groups as well as the impacts to non‐agricultural sectors and the local tax base. Given imminent water cutbacks, access to low‐cost data and information that are easy to interpret is essential for effective community dialogue.
abstract_zh: 面对科罗拉多河即将宣布的短缺状况，以及农业地表水供应的削减，农村利益相关方群体担心供水缩减将如何影响其地方经济。当地农业团体和县政府往往缺乏衡量此类影响的分析工具。虽然大规模水文经济模型可以提供丰富的启示，但数据、成本和时间的限制一直是构建此类模型的障碍。本文介绍了三种基础建模方法，利用成本相对较低且易于获取的数据，考察农业用水重新配置对地方经济的影响。一项实证应用估计了农业用水减少对亚利桑那州皮纳尔县（Pinal County）的影响，该县是科罗拉多河短缺宣告下受影响最大的县。农业用水缩减通过两种“配给”模型变体进行建模，分别假设农场主会休耕单位水量（每英亩英尺）毛收益最低（配给模型I）或净收益最低（配给模型II）的耕地。配给模型对数据的要求相对较低，前提是具备特定作物和地区的数据。在这些较为简单的配给模型基础上，投入产出（I-O）模型提供了更详细的信息，包括对不同农村利益相关方群体的影响，以及对非农业部门和地方税基的影响。鉴于即将到来的用水缩减，获取低成本数据和易于解释的信息，对于有效的社区对话至关重要。

title: A weed management game: A teaching tool
Dynamics of antibiotic and pesticide susceptibility and the Anthropocene operating space
Evaluating gravity flow irrigation, with lessons from Yuma, Arizona, USA
abstract: Many consider gravity-flow irrigation inefficient and deride its use. Yet, there are cases where gravity-flow irrigation can play an important role in highly productive and profitable agriculture. This perspective article reviews the literature on the profitability and efficiency of gravity systems. It then reviews the history of water management in Yuma, Arizona, which is one of the most productive agricultural areas in the United States. Through extensive changes in irrigation technologies, changes in production practices, and investments in irrigation infrastructure, Yuma agriculture dramatically shifted from perennial and summer-centric crop production to winter-centric, multi-crop systems that are focused on high-value vegetable crops. These innovations have led to improvement in various irrigation efficiency measures and overall water conservation. Return flows from the system, which were once characterized as an indicator of inefficiency, provide valuable environmental services to the Colorado River Delta ecosystem. Yuma’s history illustrates that innovative gravity-flow systems can be productive and water-conserving, and that a system-wide perspective is critical in evaluating irrigation systems.
abstract_zh: 许多人认为重力灌溉效率低下，并对其加以贬斥。然而，在一些高产且盈利的农业中，重力灌溉可以发挥重要作用。本篇观点文章回顾了关于重力灌溉系统盈利能力与效率的文献。随后回顾了亚利桑那州尤马（Yuma）的水资源管理历史，该地区是美国最具生产力的农业区之一。通过灌溉技术的广泛变革、生产方式的改变以及对灌溉基础设施的投资，尤马农业从以多年生作物和夏季作物为中心的生产，急剧转向以冬季为中心、以高价值蔬菜为重点的多作物系统。这些创新提高了各项灌溉效率指标，并实现了整体节水。曾被视为低效率标志的系统回归水，如今为科罗拉多河三角洲生态系统提供了宝贵的环境服务。尤马的历史表明，创新的重力灌溉系统既可以高产，也可以节水，而且在评价灌溉系统时，系统层面的整体视角至关重要。

Climate and choice of irrigation technology: implications for climate adaptation
venue: Journal of Natural Resources Policy Research
abstract: Because studies of irrigation technology adoption often concentrate on small geographic areas with the same climate, few have estimated effects of climate on irrigation technology choice. This study examines the choice of sprinkler versus gravity-flow irrigation across 17 western states. Analysis considers long-term seasonal temperatures and growing season length. An erosion index captures effects of rainfall, field slope, and soil water-holding capacity. Sprinkler adoption increases with reliance on groundwater, pumping costs, farm wage growth, and erosion. Sprinkler adoption was significantly lower for smaller farms. In colder climates, climate warming may lengthen the growing season, but increase susceptibility to frost during the expanded growth period, which may encourage sprinkler adoption. In warmer areas, there is less scope to adapt to warming by switching from gravity to sprinkler technology. Sprinkler adoption declines monotonically in Spring/Summer temperature and growing-season-adjusted Fall/Winter temperature. A drier climate would reduce sprinkler adoption, while climates with more rainfall and more intense rain events would see greater adoption.
abstract_zh: 由于灌溉技术采用研究通常集中于气候相同的小地理区域，很少有研究估计气候对灌溉技术选择的影响。本研究考察了美国西部17个州中喷灌与重力灌溉之间的选择。分析考虑了长期的季节性温度和生长季长度。侵蚀指数综合反映了降雨、田块坡度和土壤持水能力的影响。喷灌的采用随对地下水的依赖程度、抽水成本、农业工资增长以及侵蚀程度的提高而增加。小规模农场的喷灌采用率显著较低。在寒冷气候下，气候变暖可能延长生长季，但也会增加在延长的生长期内遭受霜冻的风险，这可能促使农场主采用喷灌。在温暖地区，通过从重力灌溉转向喷灌来适应气候变暖的空间较小。喷灌的采用率随春夏季温度以及经生长季调整后的秋冬季温度的升高而单调下降。气候变干会减少喷灌的采用，而降雨更多、降雨事件更强烈的气候则会带来更多的喷灌采用。

title: Climate change mitigation policies: Implications for agriculture and water resources
venue: Journal of Contemporary Water Research and Education
abstract: This study examines how the proposed American Clean Energy and Security Act (H.R. 2454) would affect U.S. agriculture with special reference to water resources. The bill's cap and trade provisions for greenhouse gases would significantly raise fertilizer, irrigation pumping, and other energy‐related costs. By 2030, it would reduce U.S. irrigation water use by >11 percent and fertilizer use by >18 percent with positive implications for water conservation and quality. Carbon offset provisions create financial incentives for farmers to sequester carbon by planting trees on cropland, reducing agricultural production and raising prices. Because sequestration potential differs by region, most of the estimated 51 million acres of converted cropland would be in the Corn Belt and Mississippi Delta. Afforestation would reduce Delta water use further, but increase water use in other regions compared to cap and trade alone. Compared to a no‐policy baseline, irrigation water use declines 10 percent nationally, but increases in the Southern Plains. H.R. 2454 may have significant water conservation effects in some regions, but increase competition for water in others. By reducing fertilizer use and dramatically altering land use patterns in parts of the Mississippi Basin, it may also provide unexpected water quality benefits. Unintended water use and quality consequences of climate policies merit further research.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了拟议中的《美国清洁能源与安全法案》（H.R. 2454）将如何影响美国农业，并特别关注水资源。该法案针对温室气体的总量控制与交易条款将显著提高化肥、灌溉抽水及其他能源相关成本。到2030年，该法案将使美国灌溉用水量减少超过11%，化肥使用量减少超过18%，对节水和水质产生积极影响。碳抵消条款为农场主通过在耕地上植树固碳提供了财务激励，但会减少农业生产并推高价格。由于不同地区的固碳潜力存在差异，估计约5100万英亩转为林地的耕地中，大部分将位于玉米带和密西西比三角洲。与仅实行总量控制与交易相比，造林将进一步减少三角洲地区的用水，但会增加其他地区的用水。与无政策基准情景相比，全国灌溉用水减少10%，但南部平原地区的用水有所增加。H.R. 2454可能在某些地区产生显著的节水效应，但会加剧其他地区的水资源竞争。通过减少化肥使用并显著改变密西西比流域部分地区的土地利用格局，它还可能带来意想不到的水质效益。气候政策在用水和水质方面的非预期后果值得进一步研究。

title: Framing scenarios of binational water policy with a tool to visualize, quantify and valuate changes in ecosystem services
abstract: In the Santa Cruz Watershed, located on the Arizona-Sonora portion of the U.S.-Mexico border, an international wastewater treatment plant treats wastewater from cities on both sides of the border, before discharging it into the river in Arizona. These artificial flows often subsidize important perennial surface water ecosystems in the region. An explicit understanding of the benefits of maintaining instream flow for present and future generations requires the ability to assess and understand the important trade-offs implicit in water-resource management decisions. In this paper, we outline an approach for modeling and visualizing impacts of management decisions in terms of rare terrestrial and aquatic wildlife, vegetation, surface water, groundwater recharge, real-estate values and socio-environmental vulnerable communities. We identify and quantify ecosystem services and model the potential reduction in effluent discharge to the U.S. that is under scrutiny by binational water policy makers and of concern to stakeholders. Results of service provisioning are presented, and implications for policy makers and resource managers are discussed. This paper presents a robust ecosystem services assessment of multiple scenarios of watershed management as a means to discern eco-hydrological responses and consider their potential values for future generations living in the borderlands.
abstract_zh: 在位于美国—墨西哥边境亚利桑那—索诺拉段的圣克鲁斯流域（Santa Cruz Watershed），一座国际污水处理厂处理边境两侧城市的废水，之后将其排入亚利桑那州的河流。这些人工水流通常为该地区重要的常年性地表水生态系统提供补给。要明确理解维持河道生态流量对当代人和后代的益处，就需要能够评估和理解水资源管理决策中隐含的重要权衡。本文提出了一种建模与可视化方法，用以刻画管理决策对珍稀陆生和水生野生动物、植被、地表水、地下水补给、房地产价值以及社会环境弱势社区的影响。我们识别并量化了生态系统服务，并模拟了向美国排放的废水可能减少的量，这一问题正受到双边水政策制定者的审视，也是利益相关方所关切的。本文介绍了服务供给的结果，并讨论了对政策制定者和资源管理者的启示。本文对流域管理的多种情景进行了稳健的生态系统服务评估，以辨识生态水文响应，并考量这些响应对生活在边境地区的未来世代的潜在价值。

title: Invasive species control based on a cooperative game
Use of weather information for agricultural decision making
abstract: This study uses data from a special subsample of the National Agricultural, Food, and Public Policy Preference Survey to assess use of weather data for agricultural decision making. Responses from 284 Arizona farmers and ranchers were used to examine (i) the importance producers placed on different types of weather data for production and marketing decisions; (ii) which producer characteristics accounted for differences in the importance they placed on weather data; (iii) producer use of weather data for specific production and marketing decisions; and (iv) which factors distinguish weather data users from nonusers. A model of demand for weather information was developed and used to specify count data and discrete choice multivariate regression models. The intensity of weather data use was greater among producers with diversified agricultural production. Diversified producers were more likely to use data for timing of planting, cultivation, and harvest. Weather data use was lower among producers with greater reliance on off-farm income. Producers who rated government risk-management programs as important also found more weather data types important and used weather data for more decisions. Access to satellite TV increased data use but access to the Internet did not.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用全国农业、食品与公共政策偏好调查（National Agricultural, Food, and Public Policy Preference Survey）的一个特别子样本数据，评估农业决策中天气数据的使用情况。研究使用了来自亚利桑那州284名农场主和牧场主的回复，考察以下方面：(i) 生产者对不同类型天气数据在生产和营销决策中的重视程度；(ii) 哪些生产者特征导致其对天气数据的重视程度存在差异；(iii) 生产者在特定生产和营销决策中使用天气数据的情况；以及 (iv) 哪些因素区分了天气数据的使用者与非使用者。研究构建了天气信息需求模型，并据此设定计数数据模型和离散选择多元回归模型。天气数据的使用强度在农业生产多元化的生产者中更高。多元化生产者更可能利用数据来确定播种、耕作和收获的时机。非农收入依赖程度较高的生产者，其天气数据使用率较低。将政府风险管理计划视为重要的生产者，也更看重更多类型的天气数据，并将其用于更多的决策。卫星电视的接入提高了数据使用率，而互联网的接入则没有。

title: Water requirements for large-scale solar energy projects in the West
venue: Journal of Contemporary Water Research and Education

title: Farm size, irrigation practices, and conservation program participation in the US Southwest
abstract: The US Department of Agriculture's Farm and Ranch Irrigation Survey collects the most detailed and comprehensive data on US irrigation practices. Yet, because the data are only easily available in cross‐tab form, data are rarely used for statistical analysis of irrigator behavior. Using data from Arizona and New Mexico, this study illustrates how statistical measures of association can be used test hypotheses about how farm size (measured by sales class) affects (i) use of water management information, (ii) investment in irrigation improvements, and (iii) participation in conservation programs. Parametric (Cochran–Armitage trend test) and nonparametric (Goodman–Kruskall gamma) methods yielded similar results. Reliance on low‐cost, general information was common among all size classes, while larger operations relied more on private, tailored information. Larger operations were more likely to use directly provided data (e.g. media and Internet reports) than smaller operators, who relied more on information provided by intermediaries. Smaller farms were less likely to investigate irrigation improvements, use management‐intensive methods for irrigation scheduling, or participate in cost‐share programs to encourage adoption of improved irrigation practices. Adoption of scientific irrigation scheduling methods was low for all groups, but especially low for small‐scale irrigators. There appear to be significant barriers to information acquisition, use of management‐intensive irrigation practices, and participation in conservation programs among smaller‐scale irrigators. Copyright © 2012 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 美国农业部的《农场与牧场灌溉调查》（Farm and Ranch Irrigation Survey）收集了关于美国灌溉实践最为详尽和全面的数据。然而，由于这些数据通常只能以交叉表形式便捷获取，它们很少被用于对灌溉者行为的统计分析。本研究利用亚利桑那州和新墨西哥州的数据，说明如何运用关联性统计量来检验以下假设：农场规模（以销售额类别衡量）如何影响 (i) 水资源管理信息的使用，(ii) 灌溉改进方面的投资，以及 (iii) 保护计划的参与。参数化方法（Cochran–Armitage趋势检验）与非参数方法（Goodman–Kruskal gamma）得出了相似的结果。依赖低成本的一般性信息在所有规模类别中都很普遍，而规模较大的经营者更多依赖私人定制的信息。规模较大的经营者比小规模经营者更可能直接使用所提供的数据（如媒体和互联网报道），而小规模经营者则更依赖中介机构提供的信息。小型农场不太可能调查灌溉改进措施，较少使用管理密集型的灌溉调度方法，也较少参与旨在鼓励采用改进灌溉实践的成本分摊计划。科学灌溉调度方法的采用率在所有群体中都很低，在小规模灌溉者中尤其低。对于小规模灌溉者而言，在信息获取、管理密集型灌溉实践的使用以及保护计划的参与方面似乎存在重大障碍。版权所有 © 2012 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

title: Less water: How will agriculture in southern Mountain states adapt?
abstract: This study examined how agriculture in six southwestern states might adapt to large reductions in water supplies, using the U.S. Agricultural Resource Model (USARM), a multiregion, multicommodity agricultural sector model. In the simulation, irrigation water supplies were reduced 25% in five Southern Mountain (SM) states and by 5% in California. USARM results were compared to those from a “rationing” model, which assumes no input substitution or changes in water use intensity, relying on land fallowing as the only means of adapting to water scarcity. The rationing model also ignores changes in output prices. Results quantify the importance of economic adjustment mechanisms and changes in output prices. Under the rationing model, SM irrigators lose $65 in net income. Compared to this price exogenous, “land‐fallowing only” response, allowing irrigators to change cropping patterns, practice deficit irrigation, and adjust use of other inputs reduced irrigator costs of water shortages to $22 million. Allowing irrigators to pass on price increases to purchasers reduced income losses further, to $15 million. Higher crop prices from reduced production imposed direct losses of $130 million on first purchasers of crops, which include livestock and dairy producers, and cotton gins. SM agriculture, as a whole, was resilient to the water supply shock, with production of high value specialty crops along the Lower Colorado River little affected. Particular crops were vulnerable however. Cotton production and net returns fell substantially, while reductions in water devoted to alfalfa accounted for 57% of regional water reduction.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用美国农业资源模型（USARM）——一个多区域、多商品的农业部门模型——考察了西南部六个州的农业如何适应供水的大幅减少。模拟中，五个南部山区（SM）州的灌溉供水减少25%，加利福尼亚州减少5%。将USARM的结果与“配给”模型的结果进行比较，后者假定不存在投入替代或用水强度的变化，并仅依靠休耕作为应对水资源短缺的唯一手段。配给模型也忽略了产出价格的变化。结果量化了经济调整机制和产出价格变化的重要性。在配给模型下，SM地区的灌溉者损失了65美元的净收入。与这种价格外生的“仅休耕”反应相比，允许灌溉者调整种植结构、实行亏缺灌溉并调整其他投入要素的使用，可将灌溉者因水短缺而承受的成本降至2200万美元。允许灌溉者将价格上涨转嫁给购买者，进一步将收入损失降至1500万美元。减产导致的较高农产品价格，对农产品的第一购买者（包括畜牧和乳业生产者以及轧棉厂）造成了1.3亿美元的直接损失。SM地区的农业整体上对供水冲击具有韧性，科罗拉多河下游沿岸高价值特色作物的生产受到的影响较小。然而，特定作物较为脆弱。棉花的产量和净回报大幅下降，而减少用于苜蓿的水量占该地区用水减少量的57%。

How federal farm programs affect water use, quality, and allocation among sectors
abstract: This article examines the effects of U.S. federal farm programs on agricultural water use, water quality, and the allocation of water between agriculture and other sectors of the economy. Agriculture is central to policy debates over how to allocate water between competing uses and how to control water pollution. Agriculture accounts for 80% of U.S. consumptive use of freshwater and has been identified as the largest contributor to nonpoint source water pollution. Over the last 20 years, agricultural policy reforms have greatly reduced, though not eliminated, incentives to overuse water and chemical inputs and have improved targeting of conservation programs to achieve environmental benefits. Recent changes provide greater incentives for voluntary reallocation of water from agriculture to other uses. The 2002 farm bill reverses some reforms, increasing some distortionary subsidies, while shifting conservation program priorities from environmental to income transfer objectives.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国联邦农业计划对农业用水、水质以及水资源在农业与经济其他部门之间配置的影响。农业是关于如何在相互竞争的用途之间分配水资源以及如何控制水污染的政策辩论的核心。农业占美国淡水消耗性用水的80%，并被认定为非点源水污染的最大来源。在过去20年中，农业政策改革大幅削弱了（但未完全消除）过度使用水和化学投入品的激励，并改进了保护计划的瞄准，以实现环境效益。近期的变化为水资源从农业向其他用途的自愿再配置提供了更大激励。2002年农业法案逆转了部分改革，增加了一些扭曲性补贴，同时将保护计划的优先目标从环境转向收入转移。

title: Competitive grants and the funding of agricultural research in the U.S
Genetic improvements in major U.S. crops: The size and distribution of benefits
abstract: The distribution of welfare gains of genetic improvements in major US crops is estimated using a world agricultural trade model. Multi‐market welfare estimates were 75% larger than estimates based on the price‐exogenous ‘change in revenue’ method frequently used by plant breeders. Annual benefits of these genetic improvements range from US$ 400–600 million depending on the supply shift specification. Of this, 44–60% accrues to the US, 24–34% accrues to other developed countries. Developing and transitional economies capture 16–22% of the welfare gain. The global benefits of a one‐time permanent increase in US yields are US$ 8.1 billion (discounted at 10%) and US$ 15.4 billion (discounted at 5%). Gains to consumers in developing and transitional economies range from US$ 6.1 billion (10% discount rate) to US$ 11.6 billion (5% discount rate).
abstract_zh: 本文利用世界农业贸易模型估计了美国主要作物遗传改良所带来的福利收益分配。多市场福利估计值比植物育种者常用的基于价格外生的“收入变化”方法所得的估计值高出75%。这些遗传改良的年收益为4亿至6亿美元，具体取决于供给移动的设定。其中，44%至60%归美国所有，24%至34%归其他发达国家所有。发展中国家和转型经济体获得了16%至22%的福利收益。美国单产一次性永久性提高所带来的全球收益，在10%贴现率下为81亿美元，在5%贴现率下为154亿美元。发展中国家和转型经济体消费者的收益，从10%贴现率下的61亿美元到5%贴现率下的116亿美元不等。

Data, information, and rural environmental policy: What will the next ten years bring?
abstract: The next ten years will see an acceleration of three current trends: (1) the growing use of geographical information systems, (2) increasingly detailed farm-level record keeping, tracking the location and timing of fertilizer, pesticide, and water use, and (3) increased reporting requirements for farm-level chemical use. Combined, these changes will reduce the costs of monitoring and regulating farmer behavior. Yet, they may also allow information to substitute for both inputs and for regulation. Improved linkage of agronomic, economic, and environmental data can help ago-environmental subsidy programs achieve greater environmental benefits at lower budgetary cost and can help in the design of more flexible, less costly environmental regulations.
abstract_zh: 未来十年将加速三种当前趋势：(1) 地理信息系统的使用日益增多；(2) 农场层面的记录日益详细，追踪化肥、农药和用水的地点与时间；(3) 对农场层面化学品使用的报告要求不断增加。综合来看，这些变化将降低监测和规范农场主行为的成本。然而，它们也可能使信息替代投入要素以及替代监管手段。农学、经济和环境数据之间更好的关联，有助于农业环境补贴计划以更低的预算成本取得更大的环境效益，也有助于设计更灵活、成本更低的环境监管制度。

title: Transboundary water management: Game-theoretic lessons for projects on the U.S.-Mexico border
abstract: Of the twelve million people who live within 100 km of the US-Mexico border, 90 percent are clustered in transboundary sister cities that share common water sources and pollution problems. New institutions created to address environmental concerns over NAFTA offer the promise of greater financial and technical assistance for water management in border cities. This paper reviews US-Mexico border water issues and institutions. Using insights from game theory, it draws policy lessons for institutions funding border water projects. We examine how the design of assistance programs, technical support, and pre-existing water rights and regulations affect project outcomes. The diversity and geographic dispersion of water conflicts suggests potential for applying the interconnected game approach to US-Mexico water negotiations. © 2000 Elsevier Science B.V. All rights reserved. abstract_zh: 在距美墨边境100公里范围内居住的1200万人中，90%集中在跨境姊妹城市中，这些城市共享水源并面临共同的污染问题。为应对《北美自由贸易协定》（NAFTA）引发的环境关切而设立的新机构，为边境城市的水资源管理提供了更多财政和技术援助的前景。本文回顾了美墨边境水问题及相关制度。运用博弈论的见解，本文为资助边境水资源项目的机构提供了政策启示。我们考察了援助项目的设计、技术支持以及既有水权和法规如何影响项目成效。水冲突的多样性和地理分散性表明，将相互关联博弈（interconnected game）方法应用于美墨水资源谈判具有潜力。© 2000 Elsevier Science B.V. 版权所有。JEL分类：Q250——可再生资源与保护，环境管理：水、空气、气候；Q280——可再生资源与保护，环境管理：政府政策；D740——冲突，冲突解决；D780——政策制定与实施的实证分析

The Convention on Biological Diversity and agriculture: Implications and unresolved debates
abstract: The Convention on Biological Diversity addresses two controversies that surround plant genetic resources (PGRs). One debate has been over property rights governing PGRs and the distribution of benefits from their use. The second has been over the adequacy of measures to maintain crop genetic diversity. This paper examines how these two debates are linked and reviews previous multilateral attempts to address them. The Convention signals wider international acceptance of stricter property rights over PGRs and the need for multilateral assistance for PGR conservation. However, current proposals to implement the Convention appear too limited in scope to achieve their stated conservation objectives, while several areas of controversy remain. These include debates over: (i) intellectual property protection for biological inventions; (ii) control over PGRs in international gene banks; (iii) the international biosafety protocol regulating biotechnology; (iv) mechanisms to finance PGR conservation; and (v) the allocation of funds between in situ and ex situ conservation.
abstract_zh: 《生物多样性公约》涉及围绕植物遗传资源（PGR）的两项争议。一项争议在于支配PGR的产权以及由其利用所产生的利益分配。另一项争议在于维持作物遗传多样性的措施是否充分。本文考察了这两项争议如何相互关联，并回顾了此前为解决这些争议而进行的多边努力。该公约表明国际社会更广泛地接受对PGR实行更严格的产权保护，并表明有必要为PGR保护提供多边援助。然而，目前实施该公约的方案范围过于有限，难以实现其既定的保护目标，同时仍有若干争议领域悬而未决。这些争议包括：(i) 生物发明的知识产权保护；(ii) 国际基因库中PGR的控制权；(iii) 规范生物技术的国际生物安全议定书；(iv) 为PGR保护筹资的机制；以及 (v) 原位保护与异位保护之间的经费分配。

Air pollution and farm-level crop yields: An empirical analysis of corn and soybeans
abstract: While many studies have estimated the impacts of air pollution on crop yields on experimental plots, few have estimated these impacts under actual farm production conditions. This study econometrically estimates the impact of air pollution on corn and soybean yields, controlling for weather, soil quality and management practices, using farm-level data for the eastern United States. Ozone pollution was found to reduce yields for both crops. The mean elasticity of yield with respect to ozone exposure was − 0.19 for corn and − 0.54 for soybeans. The benefits of ozone standards to protect crops, measured in terms of crop revenues, range from $17 to $82 million depending on the stringency of the standard. Over 85 percent of the revenue gains are captured by three states: Maryland, North Carolina, and Virginia.
abstract_zh: 尽管许多研究在试验小区上估计了空气污染对作物产量的影响，但很少有研究在实际农场生产条件下进行此类估计。本研究利用美国东部地区的农场层面数据，在控制天气、土壤质量和管理措施的基础上，计量估计了空气污染对玉米和大豆产量的影响。研究发现，臭氧污染降低了两种作物的产量。产量相对于臭氧暴露的平均弹性，玉米为−0.19，大豆为−0.54。以作物收入衡量，保护作物的臭氧标准所带来的效益，视标准的严格程度而定，范围为1700万至8200万美元。超过85%的收入收益由三个州获得：马里兰州、北卡罗来纳州和弗吉尼亚州。

title: Sources of agricultural productivity growth and stagnation in Sub-Saharan Africa
abstract: This paper examines sources of agricultural growth in sub-Saharan Africa. Growth in the stock of traditional inputs (land, labor, livestock) remains the dominant source of output growth. Growth in modern input use was of secondary importance, but still accounted for a 0.2-0.4% annual growth rate in three of four sub-regions. Econometric results support earlier studies that suggest that land abundance may be a constraint on land productivity growth. Growth in agricultural exports and historic calorie availability had positive impacts on productivity. These latter results suggest that positive feedback effects exist between export performance and food security on one hand and agricultural productivity on the other.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了撒哈拉以南非洲农业增长的来源。传统投入要素（土地、劳动力、牲畜）存量的增长仍是产出增长的主要来源。现代投入要素使用的增长居次要地位，但在四个次区域中的三个区域中，仍贡献了每年0.2%–0.4%的增长率。计量结果支持早期研究的观点，即土地丰裕可能构成土地生产率增长的制约因素。农业出口增长和历史上的热量供给水平对生产率具有正向影响。这些结果表明，出口表现与粮食安全之间，以及二者与农业生产率之间，存在正向反馈效应。

Biodiversity conservation and biotechnology development agreements
abstract: This paper assesses the role of Biotechnology Development Agreements (BDAs) in creating incentives to conserve biodiversity. A major cause of species loss is the conversion of tropical forests to crop and pasture land. Biodiversity conservation, therefore, fundamentally depends on the economics of agricultural land use in developing countries. BDAs can play only a limited role in a comprehensive strategy to increase incentives for biodiversity conservation. Policymakers must examine biodiversity policies in the broader context of land tenure, rural poverty, and agricultural development in tropical countries.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了生物技术发展协议（BDA）在激励生物多样性保护方面的作用。物种丧失的一个主要原因是热带森林转变为农田和牧场。因此，生物多样性保护从根本上取决于发展中国家农业用地的经济学。BDA在提升生物多样性保护激励的综合战略中只能发挥有限作用。政策制定者必须在热带国家土地保有权、农村贫困和农业发展的更广泛背景下审视生物多样性政策。

Effects of job site sanitation and living conditions on the health and welfare of agricultural workers
abstract: The lack of field sanitation on agricultural job sites increases the probability of agricultural workers reporting gastrointestinal disorders by 60%. Adverse living conditions significantly increase the probability of gastrointestinal, respiratory, and muscular problems. These three health problems do not appear to increase the probability that a worker's family is on welfare or to lower workers' earnings. Respiratory problems, however, substantially increase the probability that the worker receives unemployment compensation.
abstract_zh: 农业工作现场缺乏田间卫生设施，使农业工人报告胃肠道疾病的概率增加了60%。恶劣的居住条件显著增加了胃肠道、呼吸道和肌肉方面问题的概率。这三类健康问题似乎并未增加工人家庭领取福利的概率，也未降低工人的收入。然而，呼吸道问题显著增加了工人领取失业补偿的概率。
